completed_root_cause_groups: RC-UAT-003 local-only endpoint enforcement and invalid endpoint removal
RC-UAT-004 CRA createRoot mounting and hydration-branch removal
RC-UAT-005 canonical preview policy copy and local route status enforcement
active_external_blocker: TCP 127.0.0.1:8000 is held by unrelated Python PID 9289; launcher verification prevents this process from being mistaken for the UAT backend.

root_causes.cause: Controlled publication merge allowed a database audio conveyor to override an artifact's explicit audio-disabled state, and reader fallback could return the stale database row.
Reader manifest merging accepted manifest audio URLs even when the book response disabled audio.
UAT browser tests defaulted to production URLs and depended on a nonexistent controlled-launch status route.
The pinned Chromium binary is blocked by the host Mach-port sandbox before assertions; Firefox and WebKit are not installed in the pinned cache.
Inherited npx/npm cache is root-owned; direct repository binaries avoid that global cache.
The first full-UAT attempt invoked a newly added launcher as an executable before its file mode was available; the runner now invokes it through bash.
The host Python lacks uvicorn and this checkout did not include the static build server; the launcher now preflights uvicorn and provides a loopback-only static server.
